---
name: install-instructions
description: Tells the user how to install the team's CLI on their machine, without running the installer yourself. Use when someone asks how to install or upgrade the devbox CLI.
---

# Install Instructions

Never run the installer for the user. Print the command and let them run it.

1. Run `bash scripts/print-install.sh` and show its output.
2. Point out that the installer asks for sudo, and that they can read it first at the URL shown.
